summary: The Government of the District of Columbia, through its State Clearinghouse, reviewed the draft environmental impact statement and concluded that controlled use of off-road vehicles on public lands is necessary for the protection of those lands and their inhabitants. The District recommended that the Bureau of Outdoor Recreation proceed with implementation of Executive Order 11644. No concerns or objections were raised.
complaint_summary: The District of Columbia State Clearinghouse completed its review and recommended proceeding with implementation of Executive Order 11644, finding that controlled use of off-road vehicles on public lands is necessary for the protection of those lands and their inhabitants.

statement.text:
In conformance with ONB Circular A-95, the District of Columbia State Clearinghouse has completed its review of your draft environmental impact statement for the proposed implementation of Executive Order 11644 pertaining to the use of off-road vehicles on public lands.
Our review has indicated that the controlled use of off-road vehicles on public lands is necessary for the protection of these lands and their inhabitants. We recommend that you proceed with the implementation of the Executive Order for this purpose.
Sincerely yours,
Comer S. Connie
Special Assistant to the Mayor-Commissioner
